Thanks Marissa — looping in a quick production checklist and proposed talking points below so Nina/GreenLumen can review. Keeping this tight for a 3–4 minute final.

Production notes (short):
- Target total shoot time: 90–120 minutes (interview, two b-roll setups: dashboard & team working)
- Crew: Ben (producer/DP), 1 sound tech (remote hire), Priyom (technical interviewer)
- Deliverables: 3–4 minute cut, 30-sec social cut, stills (3).
- Location needs: quiet conference room or small studio; 10' x 12' preferred; power + ethernet ideal.

Draft talking points (ordered, 60–90s each):
1) Problem & context: what challenge you were solving (Aaron)
2) Why Redwood: selection criteria & onboarding (Nina)
3) Outcome & metrics: latency, throughput, cost numbers, operational wins (Aaron + Nina)
4) Implementation notes: what the infra team needed to do, timeline (technical)

Run-of-show (high level):
- 00:00–00:10 intro / setup
- 00:10–00:35 on-camera: Aaron — problem statement
- 00:35–01:45 on-camera: Nina — decision & outcomes
- 01:45–02:15 cutaways: dashboard b-roll
- 02:15–03:30 wrap & candid footage

I attached a short script_guidelines.docx with suggested prompts and a sample consent blurb for on-camera. Also starting a shoot_itinerary_v2.pdf that Ben can edit with exact call times.

If GreenLumen wants to pre-record answers remotely, we can accept a Zoom remote interview but recommend in-person.

—
Priyom Das
Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference
